request.style: English, choral, male solo with deep choir, organ, cello, timpani, violin, solemn and powerful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Be strong in the Lord and in his might
Put on the full armor of God
Stand against the schemes of the devil
Not against flesh and blood we go

[Chorus]
Stand firm with the belt of truth
Buckled around your waist so firm
Righteousness as breastplate placed
Feet strapped with gospel peace

[Verse]
Shield of faith in all your hands
Extinguish flaming arrows of evil
Helmet of salvation on your head
Sword of Spirit is God's word

[Chorus]
Stand firm with the belt of truth
Buckled around your waist so firm
Righteousness as breastplate placed
Feet strapped with gospel peace

[Bridge]
Pray in the Spirit at all times
With every kind of prayer and petition
Stay alert and persevere
For all the saints in the Lord

[Chorus]
Stand firm with the belt of truth
Buckled around your waist so firm
Righteousness as breastplate placed
Feet strapped with gospel peace

[Outro]
Hold your ground on the evil day
Having done everything to stand
